title: Check inherited contribution policy before research intake
applies_when: Adding a public repository to an automated contribution scout, especially when a clone contains no CONTRIBUTING file, AI/human-review rules depend on contributor status, or a technically valid fix may not be publishable.
lesson: Check contributor eligibility before expensive discovery, then recheck before publication. GitHub can inherit rules from the owner's public .github repository, absent from the target clone. Resolve the effective document using its actual public html_url repository, pin and read it; follow linked policies too. Keep technical correctness, contributor-policy eligibility and current interaction permissions separate. Pallets' linked AI policy specifically excludes AI use by new contributors; established contributors still need genuine personal understanding and authorship, not an agent-issued trust certificate. Tests or a review checkbox do not override such a restriction. GitHub interaction limits can separately prevent PR creation despite permissive written guidelines. Preserve useful private evidence, respect existing authors' patches, and redirect contribution effort instead of bypassing a restriction.
avoid_when: An absent profile/file or failed read is not permission; the profile collector does not establish live publication access. A prior contributor's reported denial is a reason to investigate, not proof that every user remains restricted. Limits can expire and policies can change. Do not transfer an organization's policy elsewhere, infer eligibility from keywords, or treat disclosure/review requirements as blanket bans. Internal reference testing does not authorize externally submitting its AI-generated output. No PR-yield or cost benefit is established by this lesson.

evidence.note: GitHub documents default community files in the owner's .github repository, their location precedence and why inherited files are not present in individual clones.

The linked policy covers all community interactions, distinguishes new from established trusted contributors, and requires genuine personal understanding and creation. Recheck this live policy before deciding eligibility; do not simplify it to a universal rule for every project or contributor.
GitHub documents temporary interaction restrictions, including collaborator-only participation that can prevent creating PRs independently of a project's written contribution guide.
